scientific_integrity: The classical carry theorem, Catalan normalization and known individual valuation census are acknowledged. Proof and finite tests distinguish infinite deductions from finite checks.
scientific_limitations: The exact joint law is for prime three and index blocks [0,3^L); no general-prime or arbitrary-cutoff assertion. A relevant 1973 paper was not examined in full, leaving a historical-priority risk.
title: Exact joint ternary valuation law for Catalan and central binomial numbers
